items.title: Iran hangs two more protesters as execution wave accelerates

featured_image.name: Iranian protesters clash with security forces as tear gas fills Tehran  streets amid nationwide unrest

items.description: Iran carried out two more executions on Sunday, hanging Mohammadamin Biglari, 19, and Shahin Vahedparast in connection with the January 2026 protests, the judiciary's Mizan Online website announced. The executions bring to at least twelve the number of political prisoners and protesters put to death since March 19, as the Islamic Republic accelerates a campaign of capital punishment against those who took part in the nationwide uprising that erupted in late December 2025.[1][2]

items.title: Ukraine drone strike damages oil pipeline at Russia's Primorsk port

featured_image.name: Russia's top oil terminal lost 40% of storage in Ukraine drone attacks

items.description:
A Ukrainian drone attack damaged an oil pipeline near Russia's Baltic Sea port of Primorsk overnight on Sunday, the latest in a sustained campaign that has crippled the country's northwestern oil export infrastructure for more than two weeks.

Leningrad Oblast Governor Alexander Drozdenko said on Telegram that Russian air defenses intercepted 19 drones over the region, but debris from one "damaged a section of the oil pipeline near the port of Primorsk, and the pipeline is being safely burned out." He said there were no casualties, and the pipeline was shut down while the fire was allowed to safely burn out.[1][2][3][4]

items.title: Fires hit Abu Dhabi's Borouge plant after Iranian attack

featured_image.name: UAE's Borouge to award EPC contract for EU2 ethane cracker ...

items.description:
Abu Dhabi authorities on Sunday responded to multiple fires at the Borouge petrochemicals plant in Ruwais after falling debris from air defence interceptions struck the facility, the Associated Press reported. Operations at the plant have been suspended while an assessment of the damage is underway, with the Abu Dhabi Media Office confirming that no injuries have been reported.[1][2]

The plant, located near the UAE's western border with Saudi Arabia, is part of the sprawling Ruwais Industrial Complex operated by Abu Dhabi National Oil Company and is set to become the world's largest single-site polyolefins complex.[3]

items.title: Iran fires missiles at Israel, Kuwait after Trump ultimatum

featured_image.name: Trump: U.S. will bomb Iran "back to stone ages" over next 2-3 weeks

items.description: Iran launched missiles and drones at Israel and Kuwait early Sunday, one day after President Donald Trump warned Tehran it had 48 hours to reach a deal or reopen the Strait of Hormuz before "all Hell will reign down on them." Kuwait and Israel said their air defenses were responding to the latest barrage, according to AFP, as the war that began February 28 entered its 37th day with no end in sight.[1][2]
